# Jubilee Multi-Tool Motion Platform — Human Hookup & Pre-Flight Manual (`jubilee`)

- **Device ID:** `jubilee` (`motion_platform`, version `1.0.0`)
- **Review Status:** `hand_authored_v1_fixture`
- **Primary Interface:** Duet 2 Ethernet / Duet 3 RepRapFirmware (RRF) Ethernet HTTP (Standalone: /rr_connect, /rr_gcode, /rr_model; SBC: /machine/connect, /machine/code, /machine/model). Do NOT hardcode HTTP passwords (M551); supply via local config or environment variables.
- **Default Endpoint:** `http://192.168.1.2`
- **Host Static IP / Mask:** `192.168.1.3` / `255.255.255.0`
- **Fallback Interface:** USB serial (115200 baud) for diagnostics, initial Ethernet enablement, or recovery ONLY. Never use USB serial as the default v1 motion channel because opening USB-serial often toggles DTR and can reset the controller.

## Completion Semantics
Every motion/state-mutating atomic service MUST append M400 (wait for moves to finish) and poll the RRF object model until state.status == "idle" and declared postconditions match (homed flags, active tool, lock sensor). NEVER treat HTTP 200 from /rr_gcode as motion completion.

## Emergency Stop Policy (Physical E-Stop Mandatory)
Software `cli-device sys abort` sends M112 over a lock-free, out-of-band HTTP channel that does not wait on ActionDriver mutexes. CRITICAL: M112 does NOT cut 12/24 V motor/heater power. A dedicated, human-tested physical emergency stop / power-cut relay within operator reach is MANDATORY before any real-machine motion. After e-stop, the daemon latches HALTED until human inspection, explicit confirmed reset (M999), and full re-homing.

## Pre-Flight Prohibitions
- Close Duet Web Control (DWC) motion controls after verifying connectivity to prevent dual-writer session contention.
- NEVER run move-to / G0 / G1 coordinate moves before homing.
- NEVER run T<n> / T-1 tool changes before homing.
- NEVER run standalone tool-lock / tool-unlock before homing or while suspended over a deck/labware.
- Verify tool lock (U-axis) is unlocked/horizontal, endstop LEDs respond, +X moves left / +Y moves toward front (top-down front view), and Z bed is visibly level.
- Confirm the deck is physically clear before confirming motion.home-all or motion.home-z.

## Field Verification Checklist (Required Before Live Hardware Use)
- [ ] Confirm controller model (Duet 2 vs Duet 3), topology (standalone vs SBC), and exact RRF version (RRF 3.x required for /rr_model; RRF 2.x requires upgrade or /rr_status fallback).
- [ ] Verify whether config.g still uses 192.168.1.2 (M552 P192.168.1.2 S1, M554 192.168.1.3, M553 P255.255.255.0) or lab LAN/DHCP, and whether HTTP password (M551) is set.
- [ ] Inspect live homeall.g, homeu.g, tpre*/tpost*/tfree*, and Z homing safety policy on the Duet SD card (read-only).
- [ ] Verify installed tool IDs, park coordinates, tallest labware height, and tool-presence / crash-detection switches.
- [ ] Verify location and actual 12/24 V power-cut operation of the physical emergency stop before first motion.

<a id="sec-ethernet-p2p"></a>
## Point-to-Point Ethernet Wiring (Official Default)
Connect host USB-Ethernet adapter directly to Duet Ethernet with static IPv4 192.168.1.3/24.

1. Hardware required: USB-to-Ethernet adapter, Ethernet cable, Duet board with Jubilee config.g (M552 P192.168.1.2 S1; M554 192.168.1.3; M553 P255.255.255.0).
2. Windows: Control Panel -> Network and Sharing Center -> Change adapter settings -> Adapter IPv4 -> Static IP 192.168.1.3, Mask 255.255.255.0, Gateway blank. Verify http://192.168.1.2.
3. macOS: System Settings -> Network -> USB/LAN -> IPv4 Manually: 192.168.1.3, Subnet 255.255.255.0, Router blank. Verify http://192.168.1.2.
4. Ubuntu/Linux: Set wired adapter to Manual IPv4 192.168.1.3/24 (matching machine gateway, no default route). Verify http://192.168.1.2 (or http://jubilee.local on RRF 2.4+).
5. Do NOT plug a default-configured Jubilee onto an office LAN; keep a closed point-to-point link unless config.g is explicitly configured for lab LAN.

<a id="sec-sd-card"></a>
## Initial SD Card Configuration (Preferred Method)
Write official Jubilee sys/ and macros/ directories to the Duet MicroSD card using a card reader.

1. Remove Duet MicroSD card while powered off and insert into a host card reader (official preferred method; USB upload is significantly more error-prone).
2. Copy official machineagency/jubilee sys/ and macros/ folders onto the MicroSD card without inventing custom firmware patches.
3. Re-insert MicroSD, power on, and confirm DWC opens at http://192.168.1.2. Then leave DWC read-only or closed during CLI operation.

<a id="sec-preflight"></a>
## Power-On & Pre-Homing Checklist
Checks required before any motion or homing command is authorized.

1. Run `cli-device --json --target duet_real sys detect` and `cli-device --json --target duet_real sys preflight`.
2. Confirm U-axis tool lock is unlocked/horizontal and endstop indicators work.
3. Confirm axis directions (+X left, +Y toward front from top-down front view) and visually level Z bed.
4. Clear the deck completely before confirming `motion home-all` or `motion home-z`.
5. Always run `--dry-run` before `--confirm` on first motion.

<a id="sec-physical-estop"></a>
## Mandatory Physical Emergency Stop & Software Abort
Software M112 is necessary but NOT sufficient; physical power-cut e-stop is mandatory.

1. Install and test a physical emergency stop button or power-cut relay that cuts 12/24 V supply within arm's reach BEFORE any motion.
2. Software abort (`cli-device --json --target duet_real sys abort`) sends out-of-band M112 without waiting on the motion lock.
3. Remember: M112 halts firmware step generation but does NOT disconnect 12/24 V power.
4. After any e-stop, inspect mechanics, clear obstacles, run `cli-device --json --confirm sys reset-estop`, and re-home.

<a id="sec-troubleshooting"></a>
## Troubleshooting `sys detect` Connection Failures
Diagnostics referenced automatically when `cli-device sys detect` fails.

1. Check Ethernet cable link LEDs on both the USB-Ethernet adapter and Duet Ethernet jack.
2. Confirm host interface IPv4 is 192.168.1.3 / 255.255.255.0 (or matches modified M554 gateway in config.g).
3. Confirm HTTP service is enabled in config.g (`M586 P0 S1`) and verify whether an HTTP password (`M551`) is set in environment/local config.
4. Verify Duet topology: standalone (`/rr_connect`, `/rr_model`) vs Duet 3 SBC (`/machine/connect`, `/machine/model`).
5. If Ethernet is unavailable, use USB serial (115200, DTR/hupcl disabled) ONLY for read-only diagnostics and enabling Ethernet.

<a id="sec-grbl-not-jubilee"></a>
## Notice: AutoDNA GRBL Simulator Is NOT a Real Jubilee
Clarifies the boundary between real Jubilee (Duet/RRF), MuJoCo twin, and GRBL benchmark emulator.

1. Real Jubilee uses Duet 2/3 + RepRapFirmware (RRF) Ethernet HTTP with object model polling and T<n> tool-change macros.
2. Target `mujoco_twin` wraps the local CAD-backed MuJoCo twin for full-catalog simulation (motion, tool pickup/park, deck/labware).
3. Target `grbl_sim` wraps the local AutoDNA GRBL 1.1 TCP emulator (motion subset ONLY). It has NO Duet object model, NO U-axis tool lock, and NO T macros; tool commands fail honestly with E_UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY.
